{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bathhouse''', located in the [[Alaphoe Gardens]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], was a large split-level [[Marble/Legends|marble]] structure on a small hill that overlooked both [[Alaphoe Lake]] and the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

The upper level of the Bathhouse contained three open bathing pools that were covered. Potted plants chairs and other furnishings lined the patio area of these pools. The primary level was sealed against the elements and its walls were covered in [[:wikipedia:Fresco|frescos]] of attractive scenes and marine animals native to the Procopian oceans.<ref name="LE" />
